q: How do I sign in to ORDO, and what does the dashboard show?
a: Open kz.ordo.education and click "Sign in". After you sign in, the dashboard opens: the home page with figures for the whole kindergarten.
steps: Open kz.ordo.education and click "Sign in" in the top right corner.
Enter the login and password sent to your email, and sign in to your account.
To return to the home page, click "Dashboard" in the left menu.
Choose the start and end dates of the period and click "Search".
Review the cards: kindergarten structure, finances, children's progress, Methodology Cabinet and Sales Cabinet. Each card has a "More" button.

q: How do I change the language or organization, or turn on dark mode?
a: Do all of this in the top panel on the right: language, organization, theme and profile menu.
steps: Click "RU" and choose the interface language: Russian or Kazakh.
Click the organization name to switch to another kindergarten or another role.
Click the moon icon to turn on dark mode.
Click your name to change your password or sign out.

q: How do I view my subscription and pay the service fee?
a: Open "Subscription" in the left menu. It shows how much is paid, how much is due and the monthly payment schedule.
steps: In the left menu, click "Subscription".
At the top, review the totals for the school year: paid, due, annual fee and the next payment date.
Switch between the "All", "Paid" and "Unpaid" tabs to find the month you need.
To pay for a month, click "Pay" in its row.

q: How do I ask the AI assistant a question?
a: Open "AI assistant" and type your question in plain words, or click a ready-made prompt.
steps: In the left menu, click "AI assistant".
Click a ready-made prompt, for example "How many children are checked in at the kindergarten today?".
Or type your own question in the field at the bottom.
Click the microphone to ask by voice, or the arrow to send text.
To start the conversation over, click "New chat".

q: Where can I see my organization's details?
a: Open "My organizations". It shows the city, district, number of children and subscription of each of your kindergartens.
steps: In the left menu, click "My organizations".
To change a kindergarten's details, click "Actions" in its row.
If you have several kindergartens, add a new one with the "Add organization" button.

q: How do I work with tasks?
a: Open "Tasks". Tasks are sorted into columns: new, this month, this week, today and completed.
steps: In the left menu, click "Tasks".
Choose a tab: "All tasks", "My tasks" or "Assigned to me".
Click a task card to open its details.
To assign a task to a staff member, click "New task".

q: Where do I store and find kindergarten documents?
a: All files are in the "Documents" section. You can filter them by category and search by name.
steps: In the left menu, click "Documents".
Choose a category: "Finance", "Children", "Parents", "HR documents" and others.
Enter the document name in the search field.
Click "View" to open or download the file.
To upload a new file, click "Add".

q: How do I create a group?
a: Open "Enrollment → Groups" and click "Add group". Enter the name, capacity, age and teachers.
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Groups".
Click "Add group".
Enter the group name, for example "Sunshine".
Enter the capacity and age category, then choose the teachers.
Click "Save".

q: How do I add a child to a group?
a: Open "Enrollment → Children", click "Add child", fill in the details, and choose the group and parent.
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Children".
Click the blue "Add child" button.
Fill in the child's last name, first name and date of birth.
Choose the group in the "Group" field.
Open the "Parents" tab and choose a parent from the list, or click "New parent".
Click "Save".

q: How do I add a parent?
a: Open "Enrollment → Parents" and click "Add user". The role is "Parent".
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Parents".
Check whether the parent is already in the list: enter their name or phone number in the search field.
If the parent is not there, click "Add user".
Fill in the full name and phone number or email.
In the "Roles and organizations" block, keep the "Parent" role and click "Create".

q: How do I mark children's attendance?
a: Open "Enrollment → Check-in", choose the date and group, mark "Present" or "Absent", and save.
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Check-in".
Check the date and choose the group.
For each child, click "Present" or "Absent".
If needed, enter the temperature and a comment.
Scroll down and click "Save check-ins".

q: How do I view and print the attendance sheet?
a: Open "Enrollment → Attendance sheet", choose the group and month, click "Search", then "Print".
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Attendance sheet".
Choose the group and month.
Click "Search".
Click "Print" to get the sheet on paper or as a PDF.

q: How do I see children's birthdays?
a: Open "Enrollment → Children's birthdays". Birthdays are grouped by month.
steps: In the left menu, open "Enrollment → Children's birthdays".
Click a month to see only that month's birthdays.
Switch the view between "By month" and "List".

q: How do I set up the kindergarten website?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Website", set the website address and save. The website is available to parents right away.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Website".
Choose a short address in Latin letters and enter it in the "Link" field.
Click "Save". "Website is available" appears under the field.
Click "Copy" to send the link to parents, or "Open website".
Click "Edit website" to change photos, and "Add page" for the public offer or privacy policy.
Upload photos of the kindergarten to the website. The "Sign up" button sends a parent's request straight to ORDO.

q: How do I work with requests from parents?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Requests from parents". Requests move through stages: new, qualification, tour, trial day, enrollment.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Requests from parents".
At the top, review the totals: all requests, new, in progress, enrolled and declined.
Click a request card to open it and move it to the next stage.
Add a request that came by phone manually with the "Add request" button.

q: How do I add a club?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Clubs", click "Add club", and enter the name, price and days of the week.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Clubs".
Click "Add club". The pencil in a row opens editing.
Enter the club name and monthly price.
Select the days of the week and click "Save".

q: How do I set up membership types?
a: A membership type is a kindergarten plan: name, price and period. Create the types once, then assign them to children.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Membership types".
Click "Add" and enter the name, price and period.
Check the list of plans. The pencil on the right edits a plan.

q: How do I view children's memberships?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Memberships". It shows the plan, discount and amount due for each child.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Memberships".
Choose a group or enter the child's IIN or full name.
Click "Search".
Click the icon on the right to open the child's membership.

q: How do I add a discount?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Discounts" and click "Add". You can then apply the discount to a child's membership.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Discounts".
Click "Add", enter the discount name and amount, and save.

q: How do I view parents' payments?
a: Open "Sales Cabinet → Kindergarten payments report". Green cells mean paid, pink cells mean no payment.
steps: In the left menu, open "Sales Cabinet → Kindergarten payments report".
Find a child by full name or choose a group.
At the top, review the totals: collected for the year, debt and collection rate.
In the table, the amount in a cell is the payment for that month. The legend explains the colors.
Click "Export to Excel" to download the report.

q: How do I add a staff member?
a: Open "HR Cabinet → All users", click "Add user" and choose the role: teacher, methodologist, cook and so on.
steps: In the left menu, open "HR Cabinet → All users".
To see only one position, choose it in the menu.
Click "Add user".
Fill in the full name and phone number or email.
Choose the staff member's role and organization, and click "Create".

q: How do I mark staff arrival?
a: Open "HR Cabinet → Staff check-in", mark "Present" or "Absent", and save.
steps: In the left menu, open "HR Cabinet → Staff check-in".
Check the date.
For each staff member, click "Present" or "Absent".
Scroll down and click "Save check-ins".

q: How do I open and fill in the cyclogram (weekly activity plan)?
a: Open "Methodology Cabinet → Cyclogram", and choose the week and group. You can use the ready-made Ordo cyclogram as is or build your own.
steps: In the left menu, open "Methodology Cabinet → Cyclogram".
Choose the school year, week and age group.
The "Ordo cyclogram" tab is the ready-made plan. The "My cyclogram" tab is your plan.
The "Use Ordo cyclogram" checkbox turns on the ready-made plan for the group. "Print" prints it.
In the "My cyclogram" tab, click "Add lesson" on the day you need.
Choose the educational area, activity and lesson, then click "Save".

q: How do I create a curriculum?
a: Open "Methodology Cabinet → Curriculum". You can generate the plan automatically for all groups or add it manually.
steps: In the left menu, open "Methodology Cabinet → Curriculum".
Choose the group and school year in the filters.
Click "Generate for all groups" to have ORDO create the plan for you.
Or click "Add plan" and fill it in manually.
The eye icon in a row opens the plan for viewing.

q: How do I generate a long-term plan?
a: Open "Methodology Cabinet → Long-term plan" and click "Generate for all groups" or "Add plan".
steps: In the left menu, open "Methodology Cabinet → Long-term plan".
Click "Generate for all groups". A plan appears for each group.
To create a plan manually, click "Add plan".
The pencil in a row opens the plan for editing.

q: How do I run a children's skills assessment?
a: Open "Methodology Cabinet → Monitoring" and click "Run". Results are shown as percentages for each skill.
steps: In the left menu, open "Methodology Cabinet → Monitoring".
Click "Run" to start a new assessment.
To find results, choose the group and type of monitoring.
Click "Fill in" to enter scores for a child.
Click "Group summary" to see the totals for the whole group.

q: How do I find a lesson (organized activity) or add my own?
a: Open "Methodology Cabinet → Organized activities list". Ready-made lessons are in the "Ordo lessons" tab, yours are in "My lessons".
steps: In the left menu, open "Methodology Cabinet → Organized activities list".
Choose the "Ordo lessons" or "My lessons" tab.
Narrow the list with filters: area, subject, type of organized activity, age.
To create your own lesson, click "Add lesson".

q: How do I create a meal menu?
a: Open "Cook's Cabinet → Meal menu". You can use the ready-made Ordo menu or build your own from the dish catalog.
steps: In the left menu, open "Cook's Cabinet → Meal menu".
Choose the week.
The "Ordo meal menu" tab is the ready-made menu. "Download" gives you the menu as a file.
To build your own menu, open "My meal menu" and click "Add dish" in the cell you need.
Find the dish in the search and click the plus next to it.

q: Where do I find the dish catalog?
a: Open "Cook's Cabinet → Dishes". It has 270+ dishes with recipe numbers and meal schedule.
steps: In the left menu, open "Cook's Cabinet → Dishes".
Choose the "Ordo dishes" or "Our dishes" tab.
Enter the dish name in the search field.
Click "Open" to see the recipe.

q: How do I keep the raw food quality log?
a: Open "Medical Cabinet → Raw food quality check". Record each product delivery in a separate row.
steps: In the left menu, open "Medical Cabinet → Raw food quality check".
Choose the month.
Click "Add record" and fill in the product, quantity and rating.
For an inspection, click "Excel" or "Print / PDF".

q: How do I carry out the morning health check?
a: Open "Medical Cabinet → Morning health check". Every morning, mark whether each child is admitted and confirm.
steps: In the left menu, open "Medical Cabinet → Morning health check".
Check the date and choose the group.
For each child, choose: "Admitted", "Admitted with restrictions", "Not admitted" or "Not at kindergarten".
Click "Confirm check-ins".

q: How do I keep the vaccination log?
a: Open "Medical Cabinet → Vaccinations". It shows how many vaccinations are done according to the schedule and which are overdue.
steps: In the left menu, open "Medical Cabinet → Vaccinations".
Find a child by full name or IIN.
Click the arrow in the row to open the child's vaccination record.
Click "Add vaccination" to enter a new record.
Click "Download 066/u" to get the form for the clinic.

q: How do I record a child's allergy?
a: Open "Medical Cabinet → Allergies" and click "Add allergy". Enter the allergen, type and measures at the kindergarten.
steps: In the left menu, open "Medical Cabinet → Allergies".
Click "Add allergy" and choose the child and allergen.
To find records, use the search and the group and allergen filters.
The top shows how many allergies of each type there are.

q: How do I track the kindergarten's income and expenses (cash flow)?
a: Open "Finance Cabinet → Cash flow". Add income and expenses, and ORDO calculates the total for the period.
steps: In the left menu, open "Finance Cabinet → Cash flow".
Choose the type, category and dates in the filter.
Click "Add income" or "Add expense".
In the "Summary" card, review the income, expenses and total for the period.

q: How do I find a parent's payment?
a: Open "Finance Cabinet → Payments". Find a payment by group, IIN, child's full name or payment method.
steps: In the left menu, open "Finance Cabinet → Payments".
Choose a group or enter the child's IIN or full name.
If needed, choose the payment method.
Click the filter button.

q: How do I take a course and get a certificate?
a: Open "Training → Courses", choose a course and click "Continue". Certificates are in the "My certificates" tab.
steps: In the left menu, open "Training → Courses".
Choose the type of course: corporate, parenting or business.
Click "Continue" on the course card.
Find your earned certificates in the "My certificates" tab.
